code_availability: mycarta toolkit: public, MIT license (LightGBM + dcor_sliding, NCC, Q-3D tortuosity features). taichiiiiiiii: public fork of a physics PF notebook. OpenKaggle/rogii-wellbore-geology-research: public source for segment selection / candidate paths / reranking but no data or scores. 8th, 22nd, 6th, 10th: writeups only [uncertain: Kaggle notebooks may exist but were not checked]. 7th: package and checkpoints shared privately on request only.
evidence_level: Competition writeups with detailed ablation tables (8th, 22nd, 6th, 7th, 10th), one blog, one GitHub toolkit README (no scores). Not peer-reviewed. Read in full via a browser render in this study (Kaggle pages need JavaScript).
extreme_summary: Beyond the top 5, the gold writeups converge on three lessons: (1) error is per-well dip lock-in that accumulates toward the toe (8th: per-well line oracle 6.44 -> 3.33; 10th: 89% of SSE beyond 1,500 ft); (2) diversity of evidence sources (typewell vs self-prefix vs neighbour/sibling pseudo-typewells, PF/HMM legs, alternate CV splits) beats model sophistication, with soft averaging rather than selection; (3) public LB (52 wells) was anti-correlated with private while leak-free 773-well CV tracked private, and learned per-well gates/routers/drift correctors consistently failed to transfer. The mycarta distance-correlation cost was only a LightGBM feature with no reported score.
task_definition: Same competition task for all: predict blind-zone TVT per row of each horizontal well from GR, XYZ trajectory, typewell and known heel prefix; pooled row RMSE.
inputs: 8th U-Net: 9 channels (hengck23 MTP input set incl. 4 dip/azimuth channels; removing them -> 11.37 vs 6.43). 8th ranker: 20 PF trajectories + trajectory dynamics, PF disagreement, GR match, geometry, nearby-surface agreement, spatial PF reliability from training-fold neighbours. 6th: 91 PF candidate curves from 6 PF configs x 5 GR references (typewell, self-prefix, XY neighbour within 1,500 ft, top-5 GR-similar neighbours, self-graft) + GR-free physical dip prior. 22nd: sibling-lateral likelihood tables (same master-log system, per-2 ft TVT bin GR bias/sigma), typewell templates (773 typewells -> 107 tops templates -> 54 master logs), PF channels, kriging prior. 10th: formation-top KD-tree point banks + regional polynomial, PF (16 seeds) + HMM candidates, 2-D ranking U-Nets. mycarta: multi-scale NCC, sliding distance correlation vs typewell, self-correlation to own prefix, Q-3D tortuosity (-0.107 RMSE, largest single group gain), signed azimuth, offset-well priors, landing-zone state.
target_parameterisation: 8th U-Net: TVT lattice H=384 rows x 0.5 ft (+-96 ft), W=768 MD columns x 16 ft; synthetic surfaces invented in u = TVT + Z space. 22nd solo: per-row dTVT with TVT = anchor + cumsum (dilated TCN); Ochir: beam DP in U = TVT + Z; Adil: signed-distance field over residual-TVT x MD chunks. 10th: state lattice on TVT, smoothness prior on dA/dMD. mycarta/Lukyanenko: row-level residual regression (persistence residual), TVT = kriged ANCC - Z + C.
output_representation: 8th U-Net: per-column categorical over lattice, expectation decode; 8th ranker: per-segment scores over 20 PF candidates converted to weights and interpolated along MD. 6th: row-wise attention soft-average over 91 candidate curves (top-k restriction hurt; full softmax best). 7th: HMM posterior -> learned emissions -> refiner U-Net point path + gated hedges. 22nd: 40-50 member shrink-NNLS + Ridge stack; Adil MTP K=4 + selector. 10th: LightGBM selector tempered-softmax blend of candidates + TCN/U-Net correctors.
architecture: 8th (Yuto leg): smp ResNet34 U-Net, 9 input channels, InstanceNorm, column-wise CE; 200 epochs synthetic-only then 50 epochs real 50% + synthetic 50% (lr 3e-5, frozen BN stats, hflip 0.5, anchor-real-prob 0.2). 8th (bluepill leg): bank of ~30 then 20 CPU PFs (GR/typewell, self-reference, spatial-neighbour, smoothing, change-point) + ~40 selector models tried (TCN, GRU/PF-MoE, CatBoost ranking, LightGBM, Perceiver/Transformer), five selectors kept, fold-safe weights. Final: 0.5 PF-ranker + 0.5 U-Net bank with a tail-25% residual correction and MeanShift spatial folds. 6th: GPU PF (about 200x faster) with fixed-lag then full ancestral smoother (Kitagawa 1996; Doucet & Johansen 2009), 91 candidates -> GBM + TCN + candidate-curve attention ensembler, global gain a about 1.03. 7th: HMM (numba banded forward-backward) 5.676 -> learned emissions 5.301 -> refiner U-Net pretrained on ~6,000 synthetic wells with fabricated first-pass errors (u_ship = truth + lognormal-amplitude low-passed random walk), finetuned 8 epochs real -> 5.209 -> disagreement-gated hedges 5.2025 (CV). 22nd: five engines merged via shrink-NNLS + Ridge with decode-parity and solo-LB-proven membership rules and a Q-vs-HMM disagreement gate (>= 11.5 ft). 10th: physics engine (kriging/IDW + PF + HMM) -> 2-D ranking U-Nets -> LightGBM selector (49 features) -> TCN corrector (eta 0.10) -> second U-Net with per-row disagreement-gated alpha -> heel-anchored gain s = 1.024.
core_mechanism: Recurring mechanisms: (a) synthetic surfaces in u = TVT + Z space with realistic piecewise-linear statistics and adversarial decoys at +-15 ft (the Eagle Ford aliasing period), kept at 50% throughout real training as a regulariser (8th: f0 7.41 -> 6.92, f1 6.76 -> 6.50, f2 5.39 -> 5.23; fold 0 later 5.06); (b) decorrelated evidence sources: self-prefix and neighbour pseudo-typewells correlate only 0.72-0.79 with the typewell leg (6th); sibling-lateral likelihood tables carry +0.73 nat/row at the true depth (22nd); (c) soft hedging instead of hard selection under genuine ambiguity (6th: top-k hurt; 8th: scores -> weights interpolated along MD); (d) training a refiner on fabricated confidently-wrong inputs so it learns when to distrust the first pass (7th); (e) disagreement between two models as a gate for how much to trust a second model (7th, 10th, 22nd).
training_objective: 8th U-Net: column-wise CE; 22nd TCN: global RMSE on reconstructed cumsum + local SmoothL1 on increments (lambda = 30 set by gradient-norm balancing, since the cumsum term front-loads gradients ~500x); 22nd Typewell Editor: measurement-consistency loss (corrected typewell sampled at true TVT must match lateral GR); 7th refiner: point regression on synthetic fabricated-error inputs then real; 6th: PF parameters Optuna-tuned on 150-600 wells.
decoding: 8th U-Net: posterior expectation, temperature 1.0. 6th: soft attention average over all candidates + global gain 1.03. 7th: HMM forward-backward posterior -> U-Net refiners averaged -> gated hedges g = sigma/(sigma+1). 10th: tempered softmax blend + projection to structural prior + gated corrections. 22nd: NNLS linear stack.
metric_consistent_decode: Mostly yes: expectations and soft averages (RMSE-optimal); 6th explicitly found hard/top-k selection worse than full soft averaging, consistent with our note that mode-seeking raises pooled RMSE. The 10th-place retrieval test is the clearest warning: over 1,025 candidates the oracle best was 2.60 but the objective's pick scored 7.09 and the posterior-weighted average 6.54 vs the chain's 6.01.
evidence_scope: Whole lateral + typewell, plus multi-well evidence: XY neighbours, GR-similar neighbours, same-master-log sibling laterals, kriged formation surfaces (6th, 8th, 10th, 22nd, Lukyanenko).
prefix_conditioning: Self-prefix used as a pseudo-typewell (6th selfGR; 22nd Ochir directional self-reference split by drilling direction; mycarta self-correlation); prefix-calibrated typewell affine (6th tw-affine; 22nd Typewell Editor robust affine on prefix). 22nd fake-anchor augmentation replays each training well with the anchor pulled back (~3x far-anchor labels; CV 6.88, LB 6.367).
propose_vs_select: Strongly propose-then-select/soft-average: 6th (91 candidates), 8th (20 PFs + ranker), 10th (engine candidates + selector), 22nd (40-50 member stack). Their main lesson: headroom comes from candidates that are wrong in a different direction; stronger selectors saturate at ~0.99 correlation with the base (6th).
physical_constraints: u = TVT + Z surface space for synthetic generation and beam DP (8th, 22nd); GR-free physical dip prior injected into PF likelihood (6th); 22nd's exact GR-normalization invariant beta = 0.99904 +- 0.001; bounded tanh gates chained to a validated prior (22nd Ochir); projection toward structural prior (10th).
dataset: ROGII Kaggle: 773 training wells, 3,783,989 scored rows; public LB 52 wells, private 148 wells (per 10th and 22nd). Hidden set more isolated: median nearest-training-well distance 683 ft vs 470 ft among training wells (10th). Hidden set contains re-interpreted copies of some training wells (22nd, Adil: 0.45 train_TVT + 0.55 pred blend gave about -0.03 to -0.05 LB).
synthetic_to_real: 8th: 200 epochs synthetic-only gives zero-shot 7.62; replacing pretrain -> finetune with mixed continuation at synth_prob 0.5 broke a 6.6 plateau. Generator: u_new = RDP skeleton of real surface (eps 2.0) + fold-local piecewise-linear deviation (segment median ~98 ft, AR(1) slope rho ~0.248, jumps 3.1%), TVT = u - Z, rejection if outside real drift envelope (<= 12 resamples), decoy_prob 0.25 at +-15 ft, real trajectory and GR residual/missingness preserved. Pretraining seed is a lottery uncorrelated with pretrain val (9.08 -> 6.50 by re-rolling). 7th: ~6,000 synthetic wells for refiner pretraining. 22nd: donor-relocation synthetic wells gave blend +-0.00 ('clearest miss'). Lukyanenko: synthetic pretraining tried once, not explored.
metric_and_performance: 8th: private gold (8th); PF-ranker OOF (stratified) 5.709, median well 2.92, P90 8.51; U-Net stratified 6.437 / group 6.847 CV, 0.7/0.3 blend 6.309; public 5.5 went to 6.7-7.0 private. 22nd: public 4.901 (rank 2) -> private 6.543 (22nd); all 50 submissions +1.47 +- 0.95 ft worse on private; CV(773) vs private Pearson +0.92, public vs private Spearman -0.48 in endgame band; best private 6.386 was a sub labeled 'overfit to CV'. 6th: CV 5.458 / public 5.626 / private 5.984. 7th: CV 5.2025 / public 5.518 / private 6.057 (later variants 6.009-6.015 private, 5.083 CV). 10th: CV 5.719 / public 5.620 / private 6.269; dropped neighbour stage would have scored 6.179. Lukyanenko: final public 6.042 / private 7.570 (93rd); particle filter 9.001 -> 7.801 public; AnchorCNN reproduction 7.148 private. taichiiiiiiii: public 6.389 / private 9.327. mycarta: no scores disclosed.
comparability: Weak-moderate: 5-fold CV over 773 wells or public/private LB, not our fixed 155-well holdout. Relative effects (e.g. group-vs-stratified blend -0.13, seed variance, soft vs hard selection) are the transferable part. Our best single model (4.84) is already below all their CVs, but numbers are on different well sets.
validation_protocol: 8th: GroupKFold by geographic clusters (MeanShift bw = 7000 ft, 40 clusters) and stratified 5-fold; the two splits make different OOF errors (residual corr 0.826; worst-30 overlap 19/30) and mixing 30% group-scheme models helped. mycarta: StratifiedGroupKFold stratified by signed azimuth, median TVT bin and XY grid bin, grouped by well; spatial BlockKFold (Verde) rejected as over-pessimistic because test wells interleave with training wells. 3rd (local 3rd.txt): 5 GroupKFold patterns averaged. 10th: paired SD of a configuration difference 0.168 on 52 wells vs 0.093 on 148, so public gaps < 0.10 are unreadable; byte-identical resubmission spread about 0.03. 22nd: 'cv_refit' (leave-fold-out refit of the whole stacker); decode-parity rule. 7th: paired bootstrap on 773 wells gave false confidence (1.75%) in a public inversion.
inference_budget: 6th: GPU PF about 4.5 min per pass over 773 wells (RTX 5070), fixed-lag 192 about 13 min. 7th: 50-65 s per hidden well on T4 after numba HMM (25 -> 12 s per decode) and dropping flip-TTA; many earlier submissions hit the 9 h wall. 8th: PF solution originally 6.5 h to score; rewritten for CPU. [uncertain] Per-well times for 10th and 22nd not reported.
repeated_layers: Explicitly the dominant failure: 8th adds decoy matches at +-15 ft (Eagle Ford aliasing period) during synthetic training as adversarial training against adjacent-bed lock-on; row-shift TTA (+-4/8 rows) did not help (+0.05 to +0.08). 6th: remaining error is a per-segment upper/lower branch choice that GR alone cannot resolve, so hedge by soft averaging. 22nd: lateral GR tracks the master log with corr 0.865 and ~12 API scatter, which is the multimodality; sharpened (honest-sigma) likelihoods failed 5/5 in PF because broad likelihoods provide implicit robustness. 10th: local matcher AUC 0.87-0.95 on perturbations but cannot find the truth among 1,025 candidates.
drift: 8th: last 25% of the well holds 41.6% of SSE because dip error accumulates; per-well constant oracle 4.58, per-well line 3.33, perfect tail only 4.61. 10th: error grows like a random walk from the heel (mean |error| 0.32 ft at 50 ft -> 4.55 ft at 5,000 ft), signed bias ~0, correlation length 400-500 ft; per-well line/quadratic/cubic oracles 6.70/5.34/4.42; drift extrapolation from the prefix 12.60 vs flat 15.91; first fifth of the scored zone predicts the last with r = 0.131. 22nd: OOF-trained drift-direction correctors CV -0.25 but LB +0.34 ('drift direction is the info wall'). Our holdout (0801_V2_ep150, 4.978): per-well line oracle 3.08, 58.6% of SSE beyond 3,000 ft past the heel.
uncertainty_and_calibration: No reliability/ECE analysis in any of them. Practical uncertainty proxies: disagreement between two refiners (7th, g = sigma/(sigma+1)), Q-vs-HMM disagreement >= 11.5 ft (22nd, CV -0.052 -> LB -0.167), log-disagreement gated alpha (10th, b0 0.35-0.50, b1 -0.08 to -0.14, stable across folds). 10th's triage: a leak-free bad-well detector (engine disagreement + matching-cost entropy) reached rank corr 0.41 but every treatment of flagged wells made things worse. 6th/10th global de-shrink gains 1.03/1.024.
where_to_use: (1) Synthetic generator (seq_NN_dataset.py Simulator): add 8th-place surface-space generation with +-15 ft decoy injection and keep 50% synthetic during real training (we train with 85% synthetic; check whether we switch off synthetic late). (2) Alternative references as extra cost-image channels: self-prefix pseudo-typewell GR and sibling/neighbour pseudo-typewell GR (gr_abs_diff against each), or sibling-lateral per-TVT-bin GR bias/sigma tables as a 'bias-corrected emission' channel (22nd: -0.42 NN screen win). (3) Ensemble protocol: train members on different fold/split schemes (stratified vs spatial-cluster group) and blend at a fixed weight rather than seed-only ensembles. (4) Gating: a disagreement-gated alpha between ConvNeXt and AnchorCNN/FastViT (per-row alpha = clip(b0 + b1 log1p|d|)) as a 2-parameter replacement for our failed learned per-point gates. (5) Evaluation: adopt paired-difference noise estimates and a decode-parity check.
error_mode_targeted: Band confusion (decoy training, alternate references, hedging), drift (surface-space synthetics), and measurement/protocol (split diversity, noise floors, decode parity).
gap_vs_our_implementation: Already aligned: our 1st-place reproduction uses the same well-as-image, column-wise softmax, expectation decode and heavy synthetic training that the 8th-place U-Net and 14th/26th lineage use; our Simulator already shifts surfaces in S = TVT + Z space; our holdout error anatomy (drift ~25%, band confusion ~51%) matches their oracle analyses. Gaps: (1) no explicit adversarial decoy (+-15 ft aliasing) injection in synthetic data [uncertain: our Simulator has many modes; not audited for an equivalent]; (2) only the typewell is used as the GR reference in the cost image: no self-prefix pseudo-typewell, no neighbour/sibling pseudo-typewell, no sibling-lateral bias/sigma tables, although 6th and 22nd found these the most decorrelated and valuable evidence (our failed XY geo-prior used neighbour surfaces, not neighbour GR); (3) we evaluate a single random 80/20 holdout; no spatial-cluster group split and no members trained on different split schemes (8th: residual corr 0.826 between schemes, blend -0.13); (4) our learned gates are high-capacity; the successful gates elsewhere were 1-2 parameter disagreement gates; (5) no heel-anchored gain or de-shrink (our own check: in-sample gain 0.98 improves only 4.978 -> 4.971 and cross-fitted it worsens to 5.011, so skip); (6) mycarta's distance correlation (dcor_sliding) is not a channel in our cost image; it is an alternative similarity to gr_abs_diff but had no reported score; (7) 22nd's exact GR normalization invariant (beta = 0.99904) is unexploited.
proposed_experiment: E1 (decoy synthetic, highest priority): in experiments/bilzard/seq_NN_dataset.py Simulator, add an option decoy_prob = 0.25 that, for a synthetic well, overwrites a random 200-800 ft segment of the rendered GR with the typewell response at TVT +- 15 ft (or +-P where P is the dominant autocorrelation period of that typewell), keeping labels at the true TVT; train 60 epochs vs the 5.47 baseline, report wrong_mode/blend/multimodal_miss shares from posterior_analysis.py and pooled RMSE with paired bootstrap. E2 (self-prefix reference channel): build a pseudo-typewell from the well's own known prefix (TVT_input, GR) binned at 0.5 ft, and add 'self_gr_abs_diff' (|GR - selfTW(level)|, NaN outside prefix coverage + an is_nan mask) to unet_static_channels in seq_NN_cfg.py; for synthetic wells generate it from the synthetic prefix. Control: baseline at 60 epochs. E3 (sibling tables): group training typewells into master-log systems (seq_NN_master_typewell.py already exists), pool laterals of same-system training wells (fold-safe, leave-one-well-out) into per-2 ft TVT-bin GR bias and sigma, and add 'sib_bias_corrected_diff' = |GR - (TW + bias)| / sigma as a channel. E4 (split diversity): train a second ConvNeXt on a spatial-cluster split of the 618 training wells (MeanShift bandwidth ~7000 ft on well XY centroids) for model selection/early stopping, then blend 0.7/0.3 with the standard member by averaging posteriors; control = two seeds of the standard split (to separate split diversity from seed diversity). E5 (tiny gate): replace learned per-point gates with alpha_i = clip(b0 + b1 log1p|p_cnx_i - p_anchor_i|, 0, 0.6), fit b0, b1 by cross-fitting on holdout halves or training OOF; control = equal-weight pair 4.69.
implementation_effort: E1 low-medium (Simulator option). E2 medium (new channel for real and synthetic wells). E3 medium-high (fold-safe table building, master-log grouping exists). E4 medium (clustering + one extra training run). E5 low.
gpu_cost: [uncertain] E1, E2, E3: one 60-epoch ConvNeXt-small run each on the RTX 5060 8 GB (same as previous 60-epoch ablations); E4: one extra full run; E5: none (CPU).
distillation_compatibility: Good for E1-E3 (training-data or input-channel changes; FastViT sees the same inputs, KD on posteriors unchanged). E4: a split-diverse teacher pair gives a smoother KD target. E5 operates after decoding, so the student would need its own pair partner.
error_correlation_with_ours: Alternative references (self, neighbour, sibling) are the most decorrelated sources documented (0.72-0.79 correlation vs typewell legs in 6th; sibling NN channels biggest screen win in 22nd). Split-scheme diversity gives residual corr 0.826 (8th) vs 0.857-0.992 for seed/checkpoint ensembles (14th, 8th). PF/HMM legs have much lower correlation (0.357 for HMM vs CNN in 8th) but are weak alone (11.94).
risk: (1) Public/private instability: several findings (neighbour stage in 10th, gates in 8th/22nd) moved CV and LB in opposite directions; our single 155-well holdout has the same small-sample problem (noise floor +-0.39 ft). (2) Neighbour/sibling information may over-represent training geometry; hidden wells are more isolated (683 vs 470 ft), so price E3 under reduced donor density. (3) Decoy injection may make the model overly hedged (broader humps, ~13% of our error) if the decoy rate is too high. (4) Seed ensembles did not help 8th and 10th (residual corr 0.992; 0.186 ft spread), contradicting 14th; measure our own diversity first. (5) Many writeups were agent-written with limited verification; numbers are self-reported.
notes: Useful measured facts: 8th pretraining-seed lottery (fold 9.08 -> 6.50 by re-rolling; pretrain val uncorrelated with final), stage-dependent noise floor (0.955 ft at pretrain ep10 vs 0.008 ft for mixed continuation); 8th post-hoc savgol/median smoothing best -0.014 (consistent with our failed continuity decode); 10th error concentration: worst 39 wells (5%) = 43.9% of SSE; per-well RMSE p50 3.31. 22nd: 773 typewells collapse to 54 master logs (same as 2nd place), and the hidden set contains re-interpreted copies of training wells (small free gain, but this is a leaderboard artifact, not rig-relevant). mycarta: within a lateral TVT and Z are uncorrelated (r ~ 0) though globally r = -0.96; tortuosity (Q-3D) was the largest feature gain for LightGBM (-0.107), AEON Catch22/ClaSP features overfit (+0.476). Lukyanenko blog: AI-agent failure modes (hardcoding the 3 visible test wells, silent OOF row drops, unverified attribution, cheap smoke tests rejecting ideas, memory pollution); kriged ANCC surface + PF + stacking reached 7.43-7.57 private, i.e. row-level tabular framing was the ceiling. Not read in this pass: 9th, 11th, 13th (synthetic factory cited by 22nd), 17th-29th except 22nd; worth a follow-up for the 13th generator.
